newsitem.title: UKRAINE: CCA plans $250 mln Ukraine investment - media.
newsitem.headline: CCA plans $250 mln Ukraine investment - media.

text.p: Coca-Cola Amatil Ukraine Ltd. plans to invest an additional $250 million in Ukraine, Ukrainian state television reported late on Thursday, following a meeting between executives and President Leonid Kuchma.
The company planned to complete a bottling plant near Kiev and construct an additional facility near the eastern city of Dnipropetrovsk, the report said.
It has already invested about $100 million in a bottling plant now operating in the western city of Lviv.

Coca-Cola Amatil executives are meeting in Kiev this week along with representatives from U.S., Australian and European financial institutions, a company statement said. --Irene Marushko, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
